summary: Monday's rip took a breather. NQ and ES both faded from overnight highs and closed below their rising ATR stops, the first real crack in the two-day run. Ranges stayed tight and the VIX is still low near 15, so this reads as a normal pullback, not a top. Gold kept sliding (down 1.68%) while crude ripped 3.16% and flipped long.

risk.note: Two of four index stops flipped down today, so trend-following longs should be smaller or flat until a stop reclaims. Vol is low; keep size normal-to-light. Standard daily loss budget, no drawdown-proximity flags. Week ahead: if NQ reclaims 30,890 and ES reclaims 7,800 on acceptance, the picture shifts back toward the long side.

psychology: After a strong up day, the hardest thing is doing nothing when the move stalls. The stops flipped today, so the easy long is gone. If you rode Monday's rip, this is the spot to protect the gain instead of pressing for more. Let the level tell you what to do. A flipped stop is just information; act on what price is doing now.
